task.title: test-hygiene 3b-2：整合非 bin-as-module 集成测试为 7 个领域套件并共享进程级锁
task.description: 将 crates/pony-agent-core/tests/ 下 209 个非 bin-as-module、非锚定顶层测试整合为 7 个领域套件（acp/observability/session_storage/stop_process/tools_sandbox/runtime_config/agent_team_goal），抽离 tests/support/{env_lock,test_name}.rs，升级 45+ 份测试互斥锁与 14 份未加锁 env/sandbox 测试，转换 3 处 #![cfg(unix)] 为模块级 cfg，并同步 scripts/file-size-baseline.json 7 条迁移路径。

evidence: Consolidated 204 non-bin tests into 7 domain suites (263 -> 66 targets, RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings all pass: acp 143, agent_team_goal 20, observability 183, runtime_config 277, session_storage 170, stop_process 201, tools_sandbox 193, plus 10 standalone pass; all gates pass)
